subject: Tyska
title: Reading comprehension: an introduction
sourceSummary: A short text where a person introduces themselves and their family, with questions about details and context.

questions.prompt:
Read the text: "Hallo! Ich heiße Jonas und ich bin dreizehn Jahre alt. Ich wohne in München mit meiner Familie. Ich habe eine Schwester; sie heißt Lea und ist zehn Jahre alt."

How old is Jonas?
questions.opener: Look for the number right after "ich bin ... Jahre alt".
questions.explanation: "Ich bin dreizehn Jahre alt" means "I am thirteen years old". "Dreizehn" is 13.

questions.prompt: Same text. Where does Jonas live?
questions.explanation: "Ich wohne in München" means "I live in Munich".

questions.opener: Look for the sentence about "eine Schwester".
questions.explanation: "Ich habe eine Schwester; sie heißt Lea" means "I have a sister; her name is Lea".

questions.prompt:
New text: "Samstags spielt Jonas Fußball mit seinen Freunden. Danach isst er Pizza bei seiner Oma. Sonntags ruht er sich aus."

What does Jonas do on Saturdays?
questions.opener: "Spielt Fußball" — the verb spielen means to play.
choices: He plays football with his friends
questions.explanation: "Spielt Fußball mit seinen Freunden" means "plays football with his friends".

questions.prompt: Same text. Where does he eat pizza?
questions.explanation: "Bei seiner Oma" means "at his grandmother's home". "Oma" is an everyday word for grandmother.

questions.prompt: Same text. What does Jonas do on Sundays, according to the last sentence? Answer in English with one word.
questions.opener: The expression "sich ausruhen" means to relax.

questions.prompt: Read the text again and write a German sentence (3–5 words) that answers: "Mit wem spielt Jonas Fußball?" (With whom does Jonas play football?)
questions.opener: The answer is in the first sentence about Saturdays.
steps: Find the relevant part of the text: "Jonas spielt Fußball mit seinen Freunden."
Pull out the answer to "with whom": "mit seinen Freunden" (with his friends).
Build a short sentence: "Er spielt mit seinen Freunden." (He plays with his friends.)

questions.prompt: What strategies help you understand a simple German text at grade 7 level?
questions.opener: You don't need to understand every word to understand the whole.
questions.answer: Look for familiar patterns: "ich heiße" (introduction), "ich bin ... Jahre alt" (age), "ich wohne in" (where you live), "samstags/sonntags" (days of the week used as adverbs, with a lowercase s). Guess unknown words from context instead of looking up every word. Read the text once for the overall gist and again for details. Look for present-tense verbs (spielt, isst, ruht sich aus) to understand what's happening, and possessive words (sein, seine, ihr) to understand who does what.
